headline: Pakistan FBR Makes Sales Tax Invoices Mandatory on Advance Payments
summary: Pakistan's Federal Board of Revenue made sales tax invoices mandatory for registered taxpayers on advance payments received against future supplies, requiring output tax declarations in corresponding tax periods.
why: Tax compliance adjustments issued by the FBR affect cash flow reporting and tax accounting procedures for corporate entities in Pakistan.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Stricter tax invoice requirements on advances impact corporate cash flow accounting.
